presentation:
FundingPips was founded in 2022 by Khaled Ayesh. Every account is simulated: you trade a demo environment, and what you earn comes from the firm's reward programme, not from a live market position.

Five models sit side by side. Zero funds you from purchase with no evaluation. 1-Step Flex asks for a single 12% phase. Standard, Pro and Flex are two-step evaluations with very different risk profiles, from 6% of static drawdown on Pro to 12% on Flex.

What you keep depends on how often you withdraw rather than on the model alone: weekly pays the least, monthly the most. Read the reward rules of the model you pick before you buy, because the Master account is where this firm concentrates its constraints.

programmes.accroche: The most room to breathe day to day
programmes.resume: 8% then 5% against a 5% daily loss — the widest of the range — and 10% of static drawdown. Three minimum days per phase, and a 3% daily loss variant at purchase for those who prefer it.

programmes.accroche: The cheapest ticket, the tightest drawdown
programmes.resume: The same 6% target in both phases, so no step up in pressure. In exchange, 6% of static drawdown and 3% a day — the tightest of the range — and the cheapest ticket, from $33.

programmes.accroche: The largest drawdown of the catalogue
programmes.resume: 10% then 8% against 12% of static drawdown, the widest of the range. The split is chosen at purchase and locked for the life of the account, so read it before you pay.

programmes.accroche: One phase, target equal to drawdown
programmes.resume: A 12% target against 12% of static drawdown, with no minimum days. The daily loss is 2% or 3% depending on the variant bought, and the Master keeps a permanent Striking System.

programmes.accroche: Funded from purchase, 95% of the rewards
programmes.resume: No evaluation and the highest share of the range, against the densest rule set: 5% trailing drawdown, seven profitable days per 30-day window, floating losses capped at 1%, no weekend holding at all.

conditions.trading: 41 simulated CFDs on forex, metals, indices, energies and crypto. Leverage runs from 1:100 on forex down to 1:2 on crypto, and a temporary tiered leverage applies to metals, energies and indices on the standard Master accounts. Maximum 20 lots per click, 1 lot on crypto.
conditions.commission: $5 per lot round turn on forex and metals, $7 on Zero, $10 with the swing or swap-free add-on and on Prime. Nothing on indices and energies; crypto costs 0.04% of the notional. Swap-free exists on MetaTrader 5 only and removes swaps on forex and metals alone.
conditions.retraits: You pick the cycle, and the cycle sets your share. The minimum is 1% of the Master size, 2% on the on-demand cycle. Processing is announced in one to three working days by card, crypto, Rise or bank transfer, plus the bank's own delay.

verdict.texte:
FundingPips has one of the widest CFD catalogues around: instant funding, one or two phases, five or six sizes depending on the model, three platforms and four reward rhythms. The 2-Step Standard is the most balanced route, with 5% a day and 10% overall; the Pro lowers the targets but leaves only 6% of drawdown. The swing add-on makes the standard models usable overnight and over the weekend, while Zero stays strictly incompatible with holding into Saturday.

The point to watch is the density of the Master rules. Striking System, risk per trade idea, news windows, consistency and profitable days all change with the model, the split, the size, the purchase date and the add-ons — so read the rules of the exact plan you are buying, not the firm's summary.

faq.question: Does FundingPips offer MetaTrader 4?
faq.reponse: No. The supported platforms are MetaTrader 5, cTrader and Match-Trader.

faq.question: Can I hold positions overnight or over the weekend?
faq.reponse: Yes during the standard evaluations. On a Master account, overnight and weekend holding need the swing add-on; without it, positions close automatically. Zero never allows weekend holding.

faq.question: Is news trading allowed?
faq.reponse: The standard evaluations set no technical window, but deliberately trading a release is not allowed. On a Master account, profit taken by opening or closing near a release can be removed. Zero forbids opening, closing or holding in the ten minutes either side.

faq.question: Which instruments can I trade?
faq.reponse: FundingPips publishes 41 simulated CFDs: 28 forex pairs, two metals, seven cash indices, two energies and two cryptocurrencies.

faq.question: Which model is the most forgiving?
faq.reponse: The 2-Step Standard has the most conventional daily and overall limits. The 1-Step Flex and 2-Step Flex allow 12% of drawdown but add other constraints, so the answer depends on your phase, your reward cycle and your style.

faq.question: Is there instant funding?
faq.reponse: Yes, with Zero. There is no evaluation, but the risk, consistency, news and weekend rules are the strictest of the range.

faq.question: How long does a reward take?
faq.reponse: FundingPips announces one to three working days of processing, then whatever your card, bank or provider adds.
